Best pho - flavor + extremely clean
Jan 2026 • Family
Hidden gem in district 1. Our 13 yo son is a self proclaimed pho addict and he has eaten pho at least 1-2x per day and Vi Pho is hands down the best one. We’ve had pho in Hanoi, Hoi an and Saigon and Vi stands out above all. As soon as you walk in, the aesthetics are clean and welcoming. You see the open kitchen and this was the first place we felt confident using their fresh vegetables and herbs. 

What we had:
Pork spring rolls - it was so fresh and delicious with the fresh vegetables and fish sauce dipping sauce. 

Pho - it was the cleanest broth - not oily but full of flavor. The pho itself was so fresh and had a bit of chewiness to it. The meatballs (which we are not typically fans of) were delicious - our guide told us they are made in house. 

The open kitchen was a good touch where you can see them make the pho and feel confident on their cleanliness. 

Overall - wish we knew about this place earlier - we would have visited daily!!!
